name: Ram bap
summary: Ram bắp is the young-corn roll. Vietnam Airlines fills it with pork, shrimp, and corn. ZaloPay names young corn, scallion, a little flour, and thin rice paper, and does not name pork or shrimp.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it crisp, rich, and nutty from the corn. ZaloPay calls the corn sweet and the wrapper crisp, with a diluted sweet-sour fish sauce.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: pork, shrimp, and young corn, fried crisp. Roll it with herbs, rice noodles, and thin rice paper, and dip it in mixed fish sauce. The printed sale unit is 500 g.
ZaloPay: young corn, scallion, a little flour, and thin rice paper, fried. Eat it with herbs and cucumber, dipped in diluted sweet-sour fish sauce.
The culture office names ram bắp at the Don An Phú festival and does not describe the roll.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. The festival ground is south of cầu Cổ Lũy, thôn Phú Thọ.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 80,000 VND for 500 g. ZaloPay and the culture office printed no price.
seoTitle: Ram bap — young-corn rolls in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Ram bắp, the young-corn roll. Vietnam Airlines prints 80,000 VND for 500 g and includes pork and shrimp. ZaloPay does not. The hour is Check on arrival.
